name: What factors beyond square footage should I consider when pricing my FSBO property?

mainEntity.name: What factors beyond square footage should I consider when pricing my FSBO property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beyond square footage, numerous factors influence the pricing of your FSBO property. These include the age and condition of the home, recent renovations or upgrades, lot size and features (like a waterfront view in Key Biscayne or a pool), specific neighborhood amenities, school districts, and proximity to desirable services or transportation. The current market demand for homes with certain characteristics, such as energy efficiency or smart home technology, also plays a role. Overlooking these qualitative aspects can result in an inaccurate valuation, despite similar square footage to other homes.
acceptedAnswer.description: When pricing your FSBO property, consider factors beyond square footage like age, condition, renovations, lot features, neighborhood amenities, school districts, and specific market demand, as these significantly impact value.
